issues.problem: D2 records read_start/read_end but neither argument to OutputCollector.build_result contains them. The existing output contract requires the actual read range, which cannot be inferred from the returned tail.
issues.proposal: Explicitly pass inputs.read_start/read_end from the service as named arguments to build_result, define their date/time and empty semantics in the original LLD, and migrate the single new-library call; do not reread source or expand SourceDescription/Statistics.

issues.problem: Each calculation constructor loads its templates. Three MACD parameter sets in one request read identical SQL files three times; the common smoothing file also repeats across MACD/KDJ.
issues.proposal: Load code-declared template text once per request during engine preparation and distribute read-only references to each calculation. Share only unrendered text; retain separate parameters, table names and state. No cross-request cache.
